notes: Focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.18 public-API witness for the Array Data Type Name rule at p. 94 l. 114. A valid-name control FOM is first accepted through public Create; the schema-valid negative FOM differs only by a period in the array data type name and must be rejected as InconsistentFOM. This demonstrates the period restriction only, not every HLA naming rule, other array-table fields, arbitrary FOMs, or conformance.
